ContractLimits.description: Negotiation bounds (§7.4), carried from 1.1 because silence must not consent: reaching a bound without agreement is `NoAgreement`, never an implicit freeze.

max_amendments.description: Maximum amendments after the first freeze.

max_rounds.description: Maximum PROPOSE/COUNTER rounds before negotiation expires.

oneOf.description: Counterproposal in flight; the bounded loop (§7.4).
Both participants accepted; freeze may happen (the §7.3 ACCEPTED box).
A frozen revision exists and work may proceed. Entered implicitly on freeze (§7.5) and re-entered on rework; this is EXECUTE.
An amendment is being negotiated against the frozen revision (§7.6).
A submission was delivered and awaits a verdict (§7.5).
Accepted after verification — the §7.3 post-verify ACCEPTED box. Terminal.
Terminal: refused after verification, or failed post-freeze exit (§7.7).
Terminal: a participant withdrew, pre-freeze only (§7.7).
Terminal: bounds exhausted without agreement, in negotiation or amendment (§7.4, §7.6). A valid outcome, not a protocol failure.

Relationship.description: Who the contract binds and how (§7.2): the machine is identical; the difference is the authority and escalation semantics attached.

oneOf.description: Parent to child, carrying a CapabilityGrant and an escalation path (§8).

Revision.description: One immutable frozen revision of the contract's interface (§7.5–§7.6).

content.description: The interface as negotiated: inputs, outputs, dependencies, acceptance criteria, budget. Free-form JSON; canonicalizable by construction.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical form of `{contract_id, revision, content}` — so two revisions of one contract can never collide by content reuse, and one revision of two contracts never collides either.

number.description: 1 for the initial freeze, N+1 for each accepted amendment.

Submission.description: A submission under a frozen revision (§7.5): artifacts by reference, evidence by reference, and the completion claim.

against_revision.description: The revision digest this submission answers. Must match the current frozen revision — a submission against a stale revision is refused.

claim.description: The performing participant's claim of completion.

Task.description: A unit of work with an owner and a completion claim (§7.1).

owner.description: The agent accountable for the work.

summary.description: One honest sentence about what "done" means.

agreed_by.description: Participants recorded as having accepted the current terms.

amendments.description: Amendments accepted since the first freeze.

escalation_path.description: The declared escalation path (§8.3): the parent chain. Mandatory for delegations, optional for collaborations.

participants.description: Exactly two participants (§7), matching the session the contract formed in.

pending_submission.description: The submission awaiting a verdict, if any.

revisions.description: Every frozen revision, in order; history is never rewritten (§7.6).

rework_scope.description: The rework scope when a verdict sent the contract back.

rounds.description: Rounds spent in the current negotiation loop.
